title: MOZ_lightmap glTF Material Extension
description: glTF extension that defines a baked light map containing linear diffuse irradiance.

texCoord.description: The set index of the texture's TEXCOORD attribute used for texture coordinate mapping.
texCoord.gltf_detailedDescription: This integer value is used to construct a string in the format `TEXCOORD_<set index>` which is a reference to a key in `mesh.primitives.attributes` (e.g. a value of `1` corresponds to `TEXCOORD_1`). A mesh primitive **MUST** have the corresponding texture coordinate attributes for the material to be applicable to it. Unlike core `textureInfo`, the default is `1`, matching existing light-mapped content that uses the second texture coordinate set.

intensity.description: A linear multiplier applied to the light map texel values.
intensity.gltf_detailedDescription: A linear multiplier applied to the RGB values sampled from the light map. The product is the diffuse irradiance incident on the surface, in lux (lm/m²).
